articles.title: Paint on the Tunnel Wall
articles.text: When the mountain tunnel reopened, a young scholar returned to the village for the ceremony. Years earlier, an accident there had forced his family to leave while the road could recover. He brought blue paint and invited children to mark the safe walking path along one wall. Their pictures showed trains, birds, and the workers who had cleared the fallen stone. The finished mural expressed gratitude more clearly than the formal speeches outside.
articles.translation: 山岭隧道重新开放时，一位年轻学者回村参加仪式。多年前，那里发生的事故迫使他的家人在道路修复期间离开。他带来蓝色油漆，并邀请孩子们沿一面墙标出安全步道。他们的图画描绘了火车、鸟和清理落石的工人。完成的壁画比外面的正式讲话更清楚地表达了感激。

articles.title: Why Artificial Color Can Fade
articles.text: An artificial color looks distinct because its molecules absorb some parts of light and reflect others. Sunlight can break those molecules apart through a slow chemical process. Heat and moisture may accelerate the change, especially when manufacturers mix unstable materials. Scientists test samples under strong lamps and measure the result with great accuracy. Their findings help museums choose safer lighting for textiles, paintings, and photographs.
articles.translation: 人工色彩之所以鲜明，是因为它的分子吸收部分光线并反射其余光线。阳光可以通过缓慢的化学过程分解这些分子。热量和水分可能加速变化，尤其是在制造商混合不稳定材料时。科学家在强光下测试样品，并非常精确地测量结果。他们的发现帮助博物馆为纺织品、画作和照片选择更安全的照明。

articles.title: Practical Exams Deserve More Credit
articles.text: A written exam can determine whether a student remembers facts, but it reveals little about applied skill. A practical task shows how learners plan, respond to mistakes, and accomplish a real goal. Universities should give such work more credit, particularly in engineering, medicine, and design. The faculty must still publish clear standards so that personal preference does not control marks. A balanced assessment combines reliable knowledge tests with evidence of competent action.
articles.translation: 笔试可以判断学生是否记住事实，却很少反映应用能力。实践任务能显示学习者如何规划、应对错误并完成真实目标。大学应给予这类任务更多学分或权重，尤其是在工程、医学和设计领域。院系仍必须公布清晰标准，避免个人偏好左右成绩。均衡的评价应把可靠的知识测试与胜任行动的证据结合起来。
